headline: Oil Prices Fall as U.S.-Iran Talks Show Signs of Progress
context: Oil prices retreated after Iran’s foreign minister said there had been “major progress” toward ending the fighting in Lebanon during the first session of high-level talks.

sources.name: The New York Times
